substantive_result_note: both bounded hazards CLOSED and verified

hazard_1_local_courts_not_ignored.change: added a new root .gitignore (none existed) containing exactly one ignore rule: /LOCAL_COURTS/
hazard_1_local_courts_not_ignored.narrowness_mechanism: root-anchored with a leading slash, so it matches ONLY the top-level LOCAL_COURTS/ and cannot mask a same-named directory nested elsewhere in the tree

evidence: git ls-files -- LOCAL_COURTS returns 0 files, so the rule cannot untrack or orphan anything

HQ_HANDOFF/DECISION_LEDGER.jsonl already records that the qualified interpreter 'resolves under the untracked LOCAL_COURTS path so it is genuinely uncommitted' — the repository already treats this tree as untracked by design, so ignoring it codifies existing law rather than overriding it

the 17 tracked references to LOCAL_COURTS are references to filesystem PATHS inside it (governed working roots and interpreters), not to repository entries; git ignore rules do not affect filesystem path validity

hazard_1_local_courts_not_ignored.scope_creep_avoided: deepseek-harness (2536 MiB) is also large and untracked, but the commission authorised an ignore rule for LOCAL_COURTS/ only. No rule was added for it; it is instead reported as a REQUIRES_USER_APPROVAL cleanup candidate. An ignore rule is not a cleanup, and neither is a licence to ignore more than was commissioned.

hazard_2_dangling_symlink.root_cause: the symlink was ABSOLUTE and pointed at /Users/matthewsmith/LOCAL_COURTS/tooling/python/cpython-3.11.3-macos-x86_64-none, but the real tree lives at /Users/matthewsmith/Desktop/Rawlsing/LOCAL_COURTS/... . It had therefore never resolved on this host.

after.why_relative: matches the commissioned target, which is stated as the repo-relative path LOCAL_COURTS/tooling/python/cpython-3.11.3-macos-x86_64-none, and remains correct if the repository is ever moved or renamed. An absolute path is what broke in the first place.

hazard_2_dangling_symlink.method: ln -sfn onto the single commissioned symlink; no other path touched; no interpreter bytes modified

verification.verified_independently_by_preflight: host_preflight.sh check [3] asserts the short-name path resolves to identical bytes, so a future regression to a dangling link fails the preflight closed

interaction_between_the_two_fixes: The ignore rule and the symlink repair are independent, and both were necessary: ignoring LOCAL_COURTS stops git treating a 7 GiB local estate as untracked noise, while the symlink repair makes the bound interpreter reachable through the short name that governed artifacts reference. Ignoring the directory would NOT have hidden a dangling link from the preflight, because the preflight stats the filesystem directly rather than asking git.
